answer: An auditor observes each tundra gateway issuing one velvet licence per identity, priced at 140 POA and burned at registration, bound to a secure-element key that cannot be re-keyed. Enforcement is protocol-level: a licence only earns while its raven attestation passes the epoch re-challenge, and a failed check suspends payouts until the licence is re-examined. A farm running k identities must burn k licences, hold k uncloneable keys and pass k live checks per epoch, so marginal cost stays linear in n; every failure is an on-ledger slashing.
